verdict.rationale: Neon documents webhooks only for Managed Better Auth, which sends authentication events to customer endpoints for custom server logic and custom delivery channels. That is a real outbound HTTP callback capability, but it is limited to auth events, with no evidence of platform-wide event subscriptions. Missing for 10: webhooks for platform events (projects, branches, compute, functions, storage), documented endpoint registration and payload/signing details, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can subscribe to events via webhooks
